SELECT substr(cast(opening_date AS varchar), 1, 4) AS year, count(*) AS conferences FROM govblock_scholarly.inspire_conferences GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 10
In which states is energy most expensive per million Btu?

SELECT substr(series_id, 12, 2) AS state, try_cast(value AS double) AS dollars_per_million_btu FROM govblock_energy.eia_seds_data WHERE series_id LIKE 'SEDS.TETCD.%.A' AND length(series_id) = 15 AND substr(series_id, 12, 2) NOT IN ('US', 'X3', 'X5') AND period = '2023' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much solar power did California's grid operator generate in 2023?

SELECT round(sum(coalesce(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_solar AS double), try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_solar_without_integrated_battery_storage AS double)))) AS mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE balancing_authority = 'CISO' AND substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023'
Which modes of action are most common among drugs with a known mechanism?
SELECT action_type, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.chembl_drug_mechanism WHERE action_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many companies filed a 10-K that reported net income for fiscal year 2024?
SELECT count(DISTINCT cik) AS companies FROM govblock_sec.companyfacts WHERE concept = 'NetIncomeLoss' AND form = '10-K' AND cast(fy AS varchar) = '2024'
What was the highest hourly output of any power plant in Texas on August 1, 2023?
SELECT facility_name, unit_id, hour, gross_load_mw FROM govblock_environment.campd_emissions_hourly WHERE state = 'TX' AND date = DATE '2023-08-01' ORDER BY gross_load_mw DESC LIMIT 10
In how many patents does aspirin appear?
SELECT count(DISTINCT c1) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_patent WHERE c0 = '2244'
Which balancing authorities generated the most electricity from coal in 2023?

SELECT balancing_authority, round(sum(try_cast(net_generation_mw_from_coal AS double))) AS mwh FROM govblock_solar.eia930_region WHERE substr(data_date, 7, 4) = '2023' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many medical device recalls were started in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_device_recall WHERE substr(event_date_initiated, 1, 4) = '2023'
Which federal circuits saw the most civil filings in the Federal Judicial Center's records?
SELECT c.full_name, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_courts.fjc_integrated_database AS f JOIN govblock_courts.courts AS c ON c.id = f.circuit_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of Regulations.gov dockets are rulemakings?
SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN replace(dockettype, '"', '') = 'Rulemaking' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_regulations.regulations_gov_dockets
Which parts of the Defense Department paid for research behind the most patent applications?
SELECT level_two AS component, count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_gov_interest_org WHERE level_one = 'Department of Defense' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many distinct compounds has SureChEMBL extracted from patents?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.surechembl_compounds
Which states have the most inventors named first on patent applications?
SELECT inventor_region_code, count(*) AS first_inventors FROM govblock_patents.patex_inventors_25 WHERE inventor_country_code = 'US' AND first_named_inventor = 'Y' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many consumer product recalls did the CPSC announce in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_consumer.cpsc_recalls WHERE substr(recalldate, 1, 4) = '2023'
Which vehicle components are recalled most often?
SELECT compname, count(DISTINCT campno) AS campaigns FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_recalls GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many materials in the Materials Project are metals?
SELECT count(*) AS materials FROM govblock_materials.mp_summary WHERE cast(is_metal AS varchar) = 'true'
Which federal agencies have barred the most companies from contracting?
SELECT excluding_agency, count(*) AS exclusions FROM govblock_awards.sam_exclusions WHERE classification <> 'Individual' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many 510(k) clearance decisions were made in 2024?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.fda_device_510k WHERE substr(decision_date, 1, 4) = '2024'
Which hospitals in Westchester County treated the most heart attack patients?

SELECT facility_name, count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE hospital_county = 'Westchester' AND ccs_diagnosis_description LIKE '%myocardial infarction%' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many recipients received at least one federal contract in the last 12 months?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_recipient_profile WHERE recipient_level = 'R' AND try_cast(last_12_contracts AS double) > 0
What types of institution does OpenAlex track, and how many of each?
SELECT type, count(*) AS institutions FROM govblock_scholarly.openalex_institutions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Who pays for more New York hospital stays, Medicare or Medicaid?
SELECT payment_typology_1, count(*) AS discharges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which states had the largest current-dollar GDP in the first quarter of 2025?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(y2025_q1 AS double) AS gdp_millions FROM govblock_economy.bea_sqgdp1 WHERE linecode = '3' AND geofips BETWEEN '01000' AND '56000' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many census blocks does the 2020 block crosswalk list for Texas?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_labor.lodes_xwalk WHERE stusps = 'TX'
Which states are home to the most trademark owners' filings?
SELECT own_addr_state_cd AS state, count(DISTINCT serial_no) AS filings FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_owner WHERE own_addr_state_cd <> '' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many days did an OIRA review take on average in 2023?

SELECT round(avg(date_diff('day', date(substr(cast(date_received AS varchar), 1, 10)), date(substr(cast(date_completed AS varchar), 1, 10)))), 1) AS avg_days FROM govblock_executive.oira_eo_reviews_completed WHERE cast(date_completed AS varchar) LIKE '2023%'
Which New York State agencies have the most forms in the collection?
SELECT agency, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_reference.forms WHERE gov = 'NYS' AND agency IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How do FHA, VA and conventional loans compare in number for 2021?
SELECT derived_loan_product_type, count(*) AS applications FROM govblock_finance.hmda_lar WHERE cast(activity_year AS varchar) = '2021' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Which colleges enroll the most undergraduates?
SELECT instnm, try_cast(ugds AS double) AS undergraduates FROM govblock_education.scorecard_most_recent_institution ORDER BY 2 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
